classification.difficultyReason: Combine Pythagoras with corresponding-side ratios in nested right triangles, retaining exact fractions.

content.prompt: In the diagram to the right:

spec.description: Right triangle PLM with altitude LN to hypotenuse PM; N is nearer P. The full-base dimension arrow lies below PM. Ordinary source blue strokes use house black.
spec.mathematics: PL=5 cm, PM=25/3 cm, angle PLM=90 degrees, LN perpendicular to PM, N lies on PM.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens, vertex labels, right-angle markers and the full-base dimension are visible.

answer.worked:
$\triangle PLN\sim\triangle PML$ (AAA): both have a right angle and share the angle at $P$.

Using corresponding sides:
$$\begin{align*}\frac{LN}{LM}&=\frac{PL}{PM}\\\frac{LN}{20/3}&=\frac{5}{25/3}\\LN&=\frac{20}{3}\times\frac{3}{5}\\LN&=4\text{ cm}.\end{align*}$$
